props.text: We make brands that age well.
North Light Studio works with founders who care about how their brand reads in 10 years. We've been at this since 2017 — eight years, 47 brands, three of which still exist.
North Light Studio is a four-person creative agency in Vancouver. We work with founders who care about how their brand reads in 10 years — not how it looks on Dribbble next month.

Our office sits on the third floor of a building on Powell Street, which is north-facing and consequently lit by the kind of cool, even daylight that photographers prefer and brand designers should. Hence the name.
We take on six to nine clients a year. Always small. Always serious. Always for at least three months.

props.title: Rebrand · 2024
props.challenge: An eight-year-old roastery whose wholesale customers had outgrown the original packaging — which was, by their own founder's admission, a logo they made in Canva at 2 a.m.
props.solution: A wordmark in custom-drawn Spectral, four bag colorways indexed to roast level, and a voice guide that tells the in-house team when to use the word "hand-roasted" (almost never).
props.outcome: Wholesale revenue up 38% in eight months. The new bags are now in 41 cafes. The 2 a.m. logo has been retired with full honors.

props.title: Book design · 2023–2024
props.challenge: An independent literary press launching its first six titles in eighteen months, with no in-house designer and an editorial taste that had outpaced its production budget.
props.solution: A reusable cover system: one typographic logic, one trim size, six commissioned illustrators. The result reads as a series without ever looking like a template.
props.outcome: Three of the six titles were stocked by Type Books in Toronto. One was reviewed in The Walrus. The press now has a waitlist of 400.

props.title: E-commerce · 2024
props.challenge: A small-batch lighting maker selling brass pendants out of a single Shopify page that loaded in 6.2 seconds and converted at 0.4%.
props.solution: Brand refresh with a tighter color story (warm cream, deep slate, brass), a new product photography direction shot on the actual studio floor, and a Shopify theme rebuilt around three categories instead of seventeen.
props.outcome: Conversion rate to 1.9% in four months. Average order value up 22%. Page load down to 1.4 seconds. Brass pendants now ship to nineteen countries.

content.heading: Three recent clients
content.subheading: Each took six to nine months. Each is still using what we made.

props.quote: I had been told for eight years that my packaging was charming. North Light was the first studio that asked, politely and on the record, whether I actually wanted it to be charming. We agreed I did not. The new bags do not look charming. They look correct.
props.author: Kenji Tanaka

props.quote: Margot — the designer, not the press — handed us a six-page brand brief on a Tuesday in March. Two years later we still use the same six pages. We have not had a single internal disagreement about a font.
props.author: Aiko Lavoie

props.quote: The brief said: "Make Lattice look like a small company that knows what it is doing." The brief was correct. They did that. Our conversion rate did the rest.
props.author: Devraj Bhatia
